description: A palace facade has a raised central block topped by a rounded dome and short finial. Stepped side wings flank a tall arched entrance, with a shallow rectangular step extending beneath the arch.
A gateway monument has two broad upright piers supporting a long horizontal lintel. A smaller rectangular block sits above its centre, topped by an attached upright cross-like ornament.

A clustered chateau has a tall rear block with a hipped roof, two pointed front turrets, and a lower sloping-roof wing on the right. Uneven overlapping walls and short finials distinguish its layered silhouette.
A chateau has a tall central rear block with a hipped roof behind two smaller pointed turrets. A low connecting wall and a broad sloping-roof wing on the right share a flat baseline.
A squat castle tower widens toward its base beneath a broad crenellated parapet. An arched doorway opens at the bottom centre, and a fork-tailed pennant flies from a pole attached to the battlements.
A crenellated castle wall with an arched gateway joins a tall pointed tower on the right. Two narrow windows mark the tower, while a fork-tailed pennant rises from the left end of the wall.
A squat defensive tower widens toward a flat base and has a large central arched doorway. Its broad overhanging parapet has three square merlons separated by deep rectangular notches.

A two-storey palace has a shallow gabled roof with projecting eaves above a rectangular upper floor. Two small square windows sit over an open lower colonnade divided by upright and slightly sloping supports.
A stepped palace mass rises on sloping walls to a small trapezoidal roof block. A lower wing extends to the right with a short finial, while angular foreground steps descend below the main wall.

A broad monument has a large arched passage beneath a rounded dome and small upper cap. A narrow drum divided into upright panels separates the dome from the rectangular base with rounded upper corners.
